items.title: Bitcoin now counts as collateral: From the CFTC to the ECB
items.summary: The Daily Wolf host Scott Melker, the Wolf of All Streets, looks past the whiplash in global markets to the quieter changes in how Bitcoin and crypto are being used. Including new CFTC staff guidance letting exchanges count Bitcoin, ether and stablecoins toward their financial resource requirements, Cross River Bank launching Bitcoin-backed consumer loans of up to $250,000, and BTCS selling more than half its ether to repay an Aave loan in a warning sign for crypto treasury companies.

items.title: 3 High-Yield S&P 500 Dividend Stocks Marked Down for Black Friday
items.summary: Three S&P 500 giants are trading well off their highs, and each one dangles a dividend that earnings can cover. But one carries a painful cut in its past, and the deepest discount may not belong to the safest payout.

items.title: JPMorgan Treasury survey shows neutral positioning ahead of PCE data
items.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan’s client poll of US Treasury note investors shows a small drop in bullishness, but the details point to fence-sitting more than a turn.

items.title: JPMorgan and Bank of America Just Sold Off. One Looks Better for Retirees
items.summary: One bank is cheaper and pays more today. The other has a thicker safety cushion and a dividend history that bounced back years sooner. For retirees, the real question is which advantage matters when the next downturn arrives.

items.title: Vicat shares rise as J.P. Morgan flags European cement pricing potential
items.summary: Investing.com -- Vicat (EPA:VCTP) shares rose nearly 2% after J.P. Morgan initiated coverage with an "overweight" rating and an €85 price target, citing an attractive outlook for European cement prices.
